beats.care: Writing both? Check both hall tickets and watch for a TGPSC notice on dates.
beats.what: TGPSC's AEE (Civil) exam is on Nov 6–7. SSC's JE test runs Nov 2–6.
beats.why: Rao says many SSC JE centres are in other states, so returning in time is hard.

cards.body: Oct 26: BRS MLA Harish Rao again asked CM Revanth Reddy to step in and move the Roads & Buildings AEE exam (Nov 6). He says over 50,000 civil engineering aspirants are affected, and that SSC has already fixed its schedule. Earlier: Roads Minister Komatireddy Venkat Reddy asked TGPSC to review dates on Oct 14; aspirants protested at TGPSC on Oct 17. Telangana Today reports no govt response so far. No new dates yet.

cards.q: Should TGPSC move the AEE exam?

cards.why: AEE posts are for engineers in state departments like Roads and Buildings.

hook: *50,000* engineers caught in TGPSC AEE vs SSC JE clash
